name: Hestra Army Leather Heli Ski gloves
summary: Five-finger ski gloves with a leather palm and replaceable liner. Select and verify the final colour and size on Amazon; Black/White size 9 is not guaranteed by this product-page link.
description: The manufacturer documents the black 30570 five-finger model with a white goat-leather palm. Its textile back resists wind and water, but the complete glove has no waterproof membrane. This is a model reference, not verification of the Canadian retailer’s selected size.

specs.value: Hestra Triton polyamide; windproof and water-resistant

specs.label: Insulation and liner
specs.value: G-Loft insulation; removable Bemberg polyester liner

pros: Replaceable liner can be removed for drying.
cons: Sustained wet conditions require additional protection.
useCases: Assessing fit and hand insulation for ski travel.
